qualification: These previously reserved observations now form old calibration. Any newly selected family must freeze before genuinely fresh reserved collection.

families.name: velocity-regimes
families.rules: y+=vy; vy=min(cap,vy+(vy < -2 ? fastAscentGravity : vy > 2 ? fastDescentGravity : apexGravity))

initialization.y: Continuous initialY in [observed first descriptor feet, observed+1)
initialization.vy: One initial velocity bounded by the first two raster intervals and the declared .03..09 acceleration range; no per-frame replacement or pose offsets.

success: One common rule/parameters must put all whole clear arcs inside their raster Y intervals with only permitted initial fractional uncertainty. The original 2px prospective tolerance is retained separately; do not substitute a calibration fit for fresh validation.
poseOrigins: No pose-specific offsets. Both cells share identical body/right-column origins; fit same-cell arcs separately as a guard.
